versions.changelog:
- Initial release of composite-scene skill.
- Merge multiple real images into one coherent picture with lighting and perspective matched automatically.
- No manual cut-out or masking required; elements combined via individual reference images and descriptive prompts.
- Supports up to 14 reference images per composition using Google Nano Banana 2 model.
- Designed for workflows like placing products or subjects into new scenes, merging elements, and style transfers.
- Includes detailed guidance on input collection, prompt structuring, model selection, and achieving realistic composites.
